description: rnaModScan filters nanopore direct RNA sequencing modification calls using Dorado modification scores, local sequence and read features. A shared neural classifier distinguishes m6A, inosine and false-positive candidates; m5C and pseudouridine have auxiliary reference- and motif-based reporting. The source archive includes dependency specifications, CPU/GPU Docker build files, prepared human reference maps with provenance, mouse RMBase source archives, the HEK293T evaluation checkpoint used for the manuscript's HeLa analyses, and a separate pooled HEK293T/HeLa deployment model. The supplied checkpoints require the documented TensorFlow 2.10.1/Keras 2.10.0 runtime. Third-party reference data retain their original terms and attribution; the software MIT License does not relicense those datasets.
notes: Software authors and affiliations follow the manuscript dated 25 November 2026. The HEK293T evaluation and pooled deployment checkpoints have distinct roles. See THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md for reference-data attribution and terms. No manuscript DOI or software DOI is supplied before publication.
